basic_details.short_information: NRLM Karnataka has opened one Block Manager – Non-Farm Livelihood post at block level in Kolar, with remuneration listed as 25000. content_sections.text: The official listing does not specify the application fee or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About NRLM Karnataka
content_sections.text: The post sits in the Non-Farm thematic of the NRLM / NRETP / SVEP programmes in Karnataka and is based at block level in Kolar. The Block Manager works with the project's block, district and state management units (TMMU / DMMU / SMMU) and with community institutions such as STLF, GPLFs, WLFs and SHGs.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post-Graduate. Experience: 3+ years of experience in the relevant field. Age: minimum 18 years, maximum 45 years. The listing prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. The listing does not name the subject of the postgraduate qualification; candidates should check the official notification for discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: NRLM Karnataka Block Manager – Non-Farm Livelihood Job Description
content_sections.text: Carry out project activities under the Annual Action Plan (AAP) of the NRLM / NRETP / SVEP Non-Farm thematic at block level. Create data sets of enterprises and entrepreneurs in the block, including a baseline survey of existing enterprises, and keep them updated in the MISs. Ensure Business Support Services for entrepreneurs in the block. Ensure marketing avenues for entrepreneurs, especially monthly markets, kiosks, e-commerce and supply to bulk buyers. Ensure enterprises have the technical information needed for their production or services. Ensure the financial requirements of enterprises are met through CIF, CEF, Mudra loans and similar sources. Coordinate among STLF, GPLFs, WLFs, SHGs and project staff. Assist in identifying and selecting Community Cadre for Non-Farm activities. Support STLF and GPLFs in running programme activities and building their capacities, especially Livelihood Sub Committees. Identify new business opportunities and markets for setting up enterprises. Identify potential entrepreneurs and ensure EDP and Skill Training in coordination with DMMU and Skill Training Agencies / RSETIs. Monitor and report entrepreneurship development activities regularly, meeting quantitative and qualitative targets per AAP. Submit MIS and monitoring reports within the defined timelines, and monthly reports on prescribed formats. Give handholding and business management support to clusters and incubated enterprises in the block. Work with Technical Support Agencies, Start-Ups, Incubators, NGOs and others to meet project objectives. Document case studies, best practices and learning notes throughout project implementation. Take up any other task given by the supervisor and TMMU / DMMU / SMMU.
